newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis news conference on GAN 1630 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis news conference on GAN 1630 GMT.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis will hold a news conference on French state-controlled insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) at 1630 GMT on Thursday, the Finance Ministry said in a statement.
The government has been in talks with loss-making GAN about a state rescue package, mainly concerning large property losses from its UIC arm.
Trading in GAN and UIC shares were suspended on the Paris bourse on Thursday morning.
The finance ministry statement gave no further information.

Sources close to the case said, however, that Arthuis would reveal the scale of the problems at GAN -- which the government wants to privatise -- and their causes and also put a figure on the amount needed to sort them out.
Analysts say a state rescue plan could cost up to 20 billion francs ($3.5 billion), much of it to cover losses and provisions at UIC and the Parixel and Baticredit property defeasance structures.

The European Commission, which vets state aid to industry in the European Union, approved a state injection of 2.9 billion francs into GAN last year and said recently any new aid will require fresh investigation.
